description: This file contains PHP code related to generating different types of graphical reports (charts) for a dashboard, including functions to get graphs by type, render cached images, and include other chart modules.

methods.name: get_graph_by_type
methods.description: Generates a specific type of graph (horizontal, vertical, pie) based on provided parameters and returns its HTML representation.

methods.name: get_graph
methods.description: Constructs HTML content for various charts including bar and pie charts, utilizing cached images if available.

methods.name: render_graph
methods.description: Checks for cached graph images; if absent, generates a new graph, caches it, and returns the HTML image tag.
